title: Mahindra Thar Roxx 5-Door First Drive Review: The Ultimate Everyday Off-Roader
subtitle: Mahindra stretches the iconic Thar formula into a genuinely practical 5-door family SUV with stellar ride comfort.
content:
The Thar Roxx is perhaps the most significant Indian SUV launch of this decade. While the 3-door Thar captured hearts with its rugged swagger, it was often constrained to a weekend toy. The Roxx addresses every single criticism with flying colors.

Built on a modified Scorpio-N platform, the Thar Roxx gains an elongated 2,850 mm wheelbase. The interior is a massive leap forward: soft-touch white leatherette dashboard elements, dual 10.25-inch screens, Level-2 ADAS, panoramic Skyroof, and a spacious 644-litre boot.

title: Tata Curvv EV Launched In India: Price Starts At Rs 17.49 Lakh
subtitle: Tata Motors enters the coupe-SUV segment with aggressive pricing, 585km range, and 5-star BNCAP safety rating.
content:
Tata Motors has officially launched its highly anticipated Curvv EV coupe-SUV in the Indian market with prices starting from Rs 17.49 lakh for the 45kWh battery variant and topping out at Rs 21.99 lakh for the 55kWh long-range model (ex-showroom).

On the exterior, the Curvv EV sports full-width connected LED daytime running lights, a blanked-off grille with an illuminated Tata logo, flush door handles, and 18-inch aerodynamic alloy wheels.

Inside, the cabin features a four-spoke steering wheel with an illuminated logo, a 12.3-inch touchscreen infotainment system with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, a 10.25-inch digital driver display, a 9-speaker JBL sound system, and a panoramic glass roof.

title: 2025 Hyundai Creta N Line Review: Hot Hatch Spirit In An SUV Body
subtitle: Firmer suspension, throatier exhaust, and razor-sharp steering turn the everyday Creta into a driver's delight.
content:
Hyundai's N Line sub-brand has created a loyal following in India with the i20 N Line and Venue N Line. Now, the flagship Creta gets the full N Line performance makeover, featuring mechanical stiffening of the dampers, a 30 percent tighter steering calibration, and a twin-tip exhaust that emits a distinct, sporty burble.

Power comes exclusively from the 1.5-litre turbo-petrol motor producing 160 hp and 253 Nm of torque.

title: All-New Maruti Dzire Scores 5 Stars in Global NCAP Crash Tests
subtitle: India's bestselling compact sedan makes history with a full 5-star adult safety rating and standard 6 airbags.
content:
The 4th generation Maruti Suzuki Dzire has created history by becoming the first Maruti car to score a certified 5-star crash safety rating in the Global NCAP assessments.

Equipped with 6 airbags, Electronic Stability Program (ESP), and pedestrian protection across all variants, the new Dzire demonstrates exceptional structural integrity and occupant compartment stability.

title: Mahindra Thar.e Electric Concept Unveiled: 4x4 AWD With 450km Range
subtitle: The born-electric off-roader features futuristic styling, high-density 80kWh battery, and zero-emission capability.
content: Mahindra & Mahindra has revealed the groundbreaking Thar.e electric concept at its signature Futurescape event. Built upon the customized INGLO modular architecture, the Thar.e boasts an exceptional 300mm ground clearance, approach and departure angles designed for extreme off-road trails, and quad-motor electronic all-wheel drive.

title: Mahindra XUV 3XO EV Confirmed for Early 2026 Launch
subtitle: To rival Tata Nexon EV with panoramic skyroof, Level-2 ADAS, and 456km claimed range.
content: Mahindra has confirmed that the electrified version of its popular compact SUV, the XUV 3XO EV, will enter production shortly. Expected to sport a 35kWh and 39.4kWh battery pack option, the 3XO EV will offer segment-first 0-100 km/h acceleration under 8.3 seconds and 50kW fast DC charging.
